Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)

from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
random.seed(18)

scene = Scene("Historic metalworking shop")
wood=(.25,.19,.115)
edgewood=(.19,.145,.09)
iron=(.16,.17,.16)
rust=(.24,.19,.13)
steel=(.37,.38,.35)
wall=(.56,.59,.53)

def add(name,node):
    scene.include(name,node)
    return node

def B(name, size, pos, color):
    return add(name,box(size,center=pos,color=color))

def R(name,r,a,b,c=iron):
    return add(name,rod(r,start=a,end=b,color=c))

def tube(name,pts,r,c):
    return add(name,sweep_tube(points=pts,radius=r,color=c))

# Worn timber floor.
for j in range(46):
    y=-6+j*.195
    for k in range(4):
        x=-7+k*3.4+(j%3)*.34
        col=(.43+random.uniform(-.045,.045),.35+random.uniform(-.035,.035),.235+random.uniform(-.025,.025))
        B("floorboard_%s_%s"%(j,k),(3.387,.187,.085),(x+1.69,y,-.05),col)
        for end in (-1.58,1.58):
            for dy in (-.057,.057):
                R("floor_nail",.008,(x+1.69+end,y+dy,-.004),(x+1.69+end,y+dy,.003),(.15,.14,.11))

# Back wall, window openings and deep masonry reveals.
B("wall_lower",(15,.26,1.9),(-1,1.75,.95),wall)
B("wall_upper",(15,.26,.65),(-1,1.75,4.85),wall)
for x,w in [(-7,.8),(-4.65,.28),(-1.75,.3),(1.25,.34),(4.2,.5)]:
    B("window_pier",(w,.29,3.05),(x,1.75,3.0),wall)

for x,w in [(-5.8,2.0),(-3.2,2.45),(-.25,2.55),(2.7,2.35)]:
    B("window_sill",(w+.28,.65,.13),(x,1.53,2.17),(.34,.34,.28))
    B("window_glass",(w,.055,2.22),(x,1.82,3.37),(.76,.85,.86))
    for xx in (x-w/2,x,x+w/2):
        B("window_frame",(.055,.12,2.28),(xx,1.68,3.37),(.27,.3,.28))
    for z in (2.25,3.35,4.49):
        B("window_crossbar",(w+.1,.13,.055),(x,1.67,z),(.27,.3,.28))
    for xx in (x-w*.25,x+w*.25):
        B("thin_glazing_bar",(.022,.08,2.2),(xx,1.64,3.36),(.48,.5,.45))

# Visible aging and broken patches in plaster.
for i in range(95):
    x=random.uniform(-7,5)
    z=random.uniform(.15,2.06)
    c=random.choice([(.46,.48,.41),(.63,.63,.55),(.51,.53,.46)])
    B("plaster_discoloration",(random.uniform(.03,.27),.008,random.uniform(.025,.19)),(x,1.608,z),c)

# Massive continuous workbench with separate, imperfect top boards.
for j in range(5):
    B("bench_top_board",(10.3,.252,.17),(-.8,-.02+j*.258,1.43+random.uniform(-.009,.009)),wood)
B("front_apron",(10.3,.14,.3),(-.8,-.2,1.18),edgewood)
B("back_apron",(10.3,.12,.25),(-.8,1.07,1.22),edgewood)
for x in [-5.6,-3.9,-2.15,-.3,1.5,3.7]:
    for y in [-.12,.98]:
        B("bench_leg",(.19,.21,1.33),(x,y,.67),(.155,.13,.088))
        B("leg_foot",(.27,.29,.13),(x,y,.1),(.19,.17,.12))
    B("lower_stretcher",(.17,1.14,.14),(x,.43,.35),edgewood)
B("long_lower_rail",(9.65,.15,.18),(-.85,.9,.38),edgewood)
for i in range(100):
    x=random.uniform(-5.9,4.1)
    y=random.uniform(-.12,1.08)
    B("bench_scratch",(random.uniform(.025,.18),.006,.002),(x,y,1.522),(.46,.39,.26))

# Open drawers and compartments below the work surface.
for x in [-4.6,-3.05,-1.4]:
    B("drawer_front",(1.14,.12,.24),(x,-.28,1.08),(.21,.18,.12))
    R("drawer_pull",.027,(x-.12,-.365,1.1),(x+.12,-.365,1.1),iron)
    for xx in [x-.12,x+.12]:
        R("drawer_pull_stud",.02,(xx,-.36,1.1),(xx,-.29,1.1),iron)
# Large pulled-out foreground drawer.
B("open_drawer_bottom",(1.3,.75,.065),(2.12,-.55,.92),(.22,.20,.14))
for x in [1.46,2.78]:
    B("open_drawer_side",(.065,.8,.3),(x,-.55,1.05),(.24,.21,.14))
B("open_drawer_face",(1.4,.09,.38),(2.12,-.98,1.04),(.19,.18,.13))
R("open_drawer_handle",.035,(1.98,-1.05,1.05),(2.28,-1.05,1.05),(.38,.35,.22))
for i in range(9):
    x=random.uniform(1.55,2.65)
    R("drawer_scrap",.025,(x,-.7,.98),(x+.12,-.25,1.02),rust)

# The central, broad, dark anvil and its tapered horn.
B("anvil_stump",(.62,.65,1.12),(-.9,.13,.57),(.20,.15,.09))
B("anvil_base",(.73,.53,.13),(-.9,.11,1.56),rust)
B("anvil_waist",(.37,.35,.35),(-.9,.11,1.78),(.27,.23,.17))
B("anvil_crown",(.88,.43,.22),(-.87,.11,1.99),(.36,.32,.25))
# Tapered horn made with a native mesh; geometry is attached through SceneAct below.
for i in range(12):
    t=i/12
    R("anvil_horn",.155*(1-t)+.009,(-.42+t*.65,.11,1.99),(-.42+(t+1/12)*.65,.11,1.99),(.36,.32,.25))
B("anvil_heel",(.32,.39,.14),(-1.47,.11,2.02),(.32,.29,.23))

# Hand-operated drill/flywheel machines.
def wheel_machine(name,x,y,z,r):
    # Pedestal, table and bearing brackets.
    B(name+"_foot",(.56,.5,.09),(x,y,1.58),iron)
    B(name+"_column",(.115,.14,z-1.56),(x+.09,y+.18,(z+1.56)/2),(.23,.23,.19))
    B(name+"_bearing",(.24,.27,.17),(x,y+.12,z),rust)
    R(name+"_axle",.065,(x,y-.22,z),(x,y+.35,z),steel)
    pts=[(x+r*math.cos(a),y-.16,z+r*math.sin(a)) for a in [2*math.pi*j/72 for j in range(73)]]
    tube(name+"_rim",pts,.045,iron)
    pts=[(x+(r-.065)*math.cos(a),y-.16,z+(r-.065)*math.sin(a)) for a in [2*math.pi*j/72 for j in range(73)]]
    tube(name+"_rim_inner",pts,.018,(.32,.33,.3))
    R(name+"_hub",.105,(x,y-.24,z),(x,y-.09,z),iron)
    for j in range(5):
        a=j*math.tau/5
        pts=[]
        for k in range(13):
            t=k/12
            rr=.08+(r-.11)*t
            aa=a+.7*(1-t)
            pts.append((x+rr*math.cos(aa),y-.16,z+rr*math.sin(aa)))
        tube(name+"_curved_spoke",pts,.035,iron)
    a=-.65
    xx=x+r*.76*math.cos(a)
    zz=z+r*.76*math.sin(a)
    R(name+"_crank",.027,(xx,y-.16,zz),(xx,y-.43,zz),rust)
    R(name+"_wood_grip",.05,(xx,y-.44,zz),(xx,y-.66,zz),(.30,.23,.14))
    B(name+"_tool_table",(.54,.44,.08),(x+.06,y-.01,1.99),iron)
    R(name+"_drill_spindle",.027,(x+.08,y-.06,1.82),(x+.08,y-.06,2.32),steel)

wheel_machine("large_flywheel",1.25,.79,2.83,.62)
wheel_machine("smaller_flywheel",-2.05,.62,2.24,.37)
wheel_machine("distant_wheel",-4.8,.65,1.98,.23)

# Main foreground bench vise, with heavy jaws and extended screw.
B("vise_mount",(.48,.5,.12),(2.7,.22,1.59),iron)
B("vise_pedestal",(.26,.29,.32),(2.7,.2,1.78),iron)
R("vise_body",.145,(2.22,.17,1.93),(3.14,.17,1.93),(.20,.21,.19))
for x in [2.42,2.88]:
    B("vise_jaw_upright",(.14,.39,.31),(x,.17,2.05),(.20,.21,.19))
    B("vise_jaw_face",(.17,.44,.065),(x,.17,2.225),(.43,.43,.38))
R("vise_screw",.048,(2.18,.17,1.93),(3.58,.17,1.93),steel)
for i in range(18):
    x=3.05+i*.023
    R("screw_thread",.058,(x,.17,1.93),(x+.009,.17,1.93),(.24,.25,.23))
R("vise_handle_hub",.085,(3.53,.17,1.93),(3.68,.17,1.93),iron)
R("vise_tommy_bar",.026,(3.64,.17,1.56),(3.64,.17,2.15),steel)
for z in [1.55,2.16]:
    add("vise_handle_end",ball(.047,center=(3.64,.17,z),color=iron))
# Long forged leg below vise.
B("vise_long_leg",(.115,.14,.92),(2.7,.12,1.04),iron)
B("vise_leg_toe",(.28,.28,.09),(2.7,.09,.59),iron)

# Smaller front-edge vise.
B("small_vise_base",(.36,.32,.08),(.1,-.05,1.58),rust)
R("small_vise_barrel",.095,(-.16,-.06,1.74),(.39,-.06,1.74),iron)
for x in [-.06,.21]:
    B("small_vise_jaw",(.09,.29,.23),(x,-.06,1.85),steel)
R("small_vise_handle",.021,(.43,-.06,1.46),(.43,-.06,1.87),iron)
R("hanging_vise_leg",.055,(.02,-.11,1.66),(.02,-.23,.38),iron)
add("hanging_leg_tip",ball(.065,center=(.02,-.23,.38),color=iron))

# Bench tools, plates, chisels, files, hammers, tongs.
for i in range(12):
    x=random.uniform(.35,1.9)
    y=random.uniform(-.05,.47)
    length=random.uniform(.28,.64)
    R("loose_file",.018,(x,y,1.56),(x+.1,y+length,1.56),steel)
    R("file_wood_handle",.035,(x-.025,y-.13,1.56),(x,y,1.56),(.30,.21,.12))
for x,y,s in [(1.8,.09,.31),(2.05,.51,.26),(3.38,.55,.3),(-2.7,.25,.27)]:
    plate=B("steel_plate",(s,.34,.025),(x,y,1.55),(.43,.44,.40))
    for dx in [-.08,.08]:
        R("plate_dark_hole",.018,(x+dx,y,1.565),(x+dx,y,1.571),(.09,.10,.09))
for x,y in [(-1.7,.08),(-3.0,.65),(-3.7,.3),(.5,.83)]:
    R("hammer_handle",.025,(x,y,1.57),(x+.35,y+.2,1.58),(.43,.31,.16))
    B("hammer_head",(.15,.29,.11),(x+.35,y+.2,1.62),iron)
for i in range(18):
    x=random.uniform(-5.5,-2.3)
    y=random.uniform(.02,1)
    R("background_metal_tool",random.uniform(.012,.03),(x,y,1.55),(x+random.uniform(.1,.35),y+random.uniform(.1,.4),1.57),steel)
for x in [-4.2,-3.2,-2.65]:
    B("small_tool_block",(.28,.24,.24),(x,.8,1.67),rust)
    R("standing_tool",.025,(x,.8,1.7),(x+.03,.8,2.02),iron)

# Window ledges crowded with oil cans, jars and upright tools.
for i in range(24):
    x=random.uniform(-6.4,3.8)
    y=1.42+random.uniform(-.07,.06)
    h=random.uniform(.09,.26)
    r=random.uniform(.035,.073)
    R("sill_can",r,(x,y,2.25),(x,y,2.25+h),random.choice([iron,steel,(.30,.24,.16)]))
    R("oil_can_neck",r*.3,(x,y,2.25+h),(x,y,2.31+h),iron)
    if i%3==0:
        R("oil_spout",.012,(x,y,2.3+h),(x+.09,y,2.42+h),steel)
for x in [-5.8,-3.9,-1.2,.8,3.4]:
    R("ledge_hand_tool",.018,(x,1.48,2.25),(x+.04,1.48,2.68),iron)

# Wall-mounted pipes, hanging shafts, hand tools.
tube("wall_pipe",[(3.66,1.52,4.65),(3.66,1.52,3.85),(3.46,1.52,3.68),(3.46,1.52,2.1),(3.67,1.52,1.92)],.035,(.28,.29,.24))
tube("left_pipe",[(-4.5,1.48,4.7),(-4.5,1.48,3.1),(-4.3,1.48,2.8),(-4.3,1.48,2.45)],.027,rust)
for x in [-3.7,-2.8,-1.55,.1,3.9]:
    R("hanging_wall_rod",.019,(x,1.51,2.5),(x+.1,1.51,3.56),rust)
    B("wall_tool_handle",(.075,.075,.23),(x+.09,1.49,3.48),(.25,.17,.095))
R("leaning_long_wood_handle",.042,(3.86,1.25,.06),(4.35,1.53,2.77),(.34,.24,.12))
R("leaning_iron_bar",.025,(-3.5,-.05,.05),(-3.2,.25,1.38),iron)

# Bins, cans and stored material under the bench.
def bucket(name,x,y,z,r,h,c):
    # Open top, metal staves and an interior visible from above.
    R(name+"_base",r*.91,(x,y,z),(x,y,z+.035),c)
    for j in range(32):
        a=j*math.tau/32
        b=(j+1)*math.tau/32
        pts=[(x+r*.86*math.cos(a),y+r*.86*math.sin(a),z),
             (x+r*math.cos(a),y+r*math.sin(a),z+h),
             (x+r*math.cos(b),y+r*math.sin(b),z+h),
             (x+r*.86*math.cos(b),y+r*.86*math.sin(b),z)]
        # Narrow vertical sections approximate the curved open shell.
        R(name+"_side",r*.103,pts[0],pts[1],c)
    for zz,rr in [(z+.05,r*.88),(z+h,r)]:
        tube(name+"_rim",[(x+rr*math.cos(k*math.tau/48),y+rr*math.sin(k*math.tau/48),zz) for k in range(49)],.018,(.31,.31,.25))

bucket("cream_bucket",2.35,-.02,.03,.36,.66,(.55,.54,.43))
R("bucket_contents",.23,(2.35,-.02,.07),(2.35,-.02,.48),(.19,.17,.12))
bucket("green_can",3.58,.22,.02,.38,.72,(.23,.28,.19))
R("green_can_lid",.39,(3.58,.22,.73),(3.58,.22,.77),(.25,.27,.19))
R("green_can_neck",.09,(3.58,.22,.77),(3.58,.22,.87),rust)
for x in [-4.7,-3.4,-1.9]:
    B("underbench_storage_box",(.65,.62,.58),(x,.52,.34),(.23,.24,.17))
    for i in range(4):
        B("stored_board",(.055,.45,.63),(x-.22+i*.13,.52,.65),(.26,.21,.13))
for i in range(10):
    x=random.uniform(-1.5,1.5)
    R("underbench_scrap",.035,(x,.62,.12),(x+.18,.75,random.uniform(.4,.8)),rust)

# Small gray museum direction marker on the floor.
R("floor_marker",.34,(-1.6,-2.2,.002),(-1.6,-2.2,.007),(.32,.40,.40))
B("arrow_stem",(.13,.25,.006),(-1.6,-2.21,.014),(.78,.80,.73))
# Arrow head constructed from three simple bars.
a=B("arrow_left",(.12,.28,.006),(-1.68,-2.08,.014),(.78,.80,.73))
a.turn('z',-43)
a=B("arrow_right",(.12,.28,.006),(-1.52,-2.08,.014),(.78,.80,.73))
a.turn('z',43)

realize(scene)

# Procedural wear is applied to the actual surfaces, without image textures.
for mat in bpy.data.materials:
    mat.use_nodes=True
    nt=mat.node_tree
    bs=nt.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    if not bs:
        continue
    col=bs.inputs["Base Color"].default_value
    bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.82
    noise=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
    noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=27
    noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value=3
    noise.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.75
    ramp=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.17
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(col[0]*.58,col[1]*.58,col[2]*.58,1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.83
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(min(col[0]*1.22,1),min(col[1]*1.22,1),min(col[2]*1.22,1),1)
    nt.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs["Fac"])
    nt.links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
    bump=nt.nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
    bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.22
    bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.025
    nt.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
    nt.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])
    if abs(col[0]-col[1])<.035 and col[0]<.46:
        bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=.55
        bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.5
    if col[2]>.75:
        bs.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value=(.72,.83,.87,1)
        bs.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value=.65

set_view((6.5,-7.8,5.0),(-.65,.38,1.55),lens=44)
area_emitter((-.8,-2.2,6.3),power=1250,size=6,target=(-.5,.3,1),color=(1,.94,.81))
area_emitter((-.8,1.2,4.3),power=1700,size=5,target=(-1,-1,1),color=(.80,.91,1))
area_emitter((-5,-.5,3.8),power=500,size=3,target=(-3,0,1),color=(.85,.91,1))
world=bpy.context.scene.world
world.color=(.22,.24,.25)
sc=bpy.context.scene
sc.render.engine='CYCLES'
sc.cycles.samples=48
sc.render.resolution_x=512
sc.render.resolution_y=384
sc.render.resolution_percentage=100
sc.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
sc.view_settings.exposure=-.25
